emerging_technology: QR codes carrying a GS1 Digital Link URI on garment tags
organization: Hypothetical midsize apparel brand with direct and wholesale channels
intended_application: Help buyers find care instructions for the exact garment variant
business_need: Compare correct care lookup with a plain URL QR before paying for standardized identifiers
users_stakeholders: Shoppers, product content lead, label supplier
capabilities_constraints: Own domain, product catalog and content editor available; two styles for a removable hangtag trial. No customer outcome or cost measurements.
risk_consequence_context: Wrong instructions can damage a garment; existing sewn-in care label stays.
management_question: Should we fund a two-style comparison this quarter?
